	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_after BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_through BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,

	failure_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

)

	block_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

	retried_at DATETIME, 
	retry_request_generation BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (block_id),

	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_topic_block_usage CHECK (attempts > 0 AND requests >= 0 AND tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_topic_block_acceptance CHECK ((retried_at IS NULL AND retry_request_generation IS NULL) OR (retried_at IS NOT NULL AND retry_request_generation IS NOT NULL AND retry_request_generation > 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_topic_block_identity UNIQUE (scope_id, binding_name, source_after, attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_atomic_memory_current (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	projection_format VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	searchable_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tag_keys TEXT NOT NULL, 
	embedding BLOB, 
	profile_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	embedding_input_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, artifact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_revision CHECK (revision > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_state_version CHECK (state_version >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_embedding_metadata CHECK ((embedding IS NULL AND profile_fingerprint IS NULL AND embedding_input_hash IS NULL) OR (embedding IS NOT NULL AND profile_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND embedding_input_hash IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pc_atomic_memory_current_fts USING fts5(scope_id UNINDEXED, artifact_id UNINDEXED, revision UNINDEXED, state_version UNINDEXED, content_hash UNINDEXED, projection_format UNINDEXED, kind UNINDEXED, text UNINDEXED, searchable_text, tag_keys UNINDEXED, identity_token, tokenize='unicode61')
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pc_memory_artifact_archive (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content BLOB NOT NULL, 
	memory_citations BLOB, 
	metadata BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision)
)

CREATE TRIGGER pc_atomic_memory_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON pc_atomic_memory_current BEGIN DELETE FROM pc_atomic_memory_current_fts WHERE identity_token MATCH ('i' || lower(hex(old.scope_id)) || 'x' || lower(hex(old.artifact_id))); END

CREATE TRIGGER pc_atomic_memory_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON pc_atomic_memory_current BEGIN INSERT INTO pc_atomic_memory_current_fts (scope_id, artifact_id, revision, state_version, content_hash, projection_format, kind, text, searchable_text, tag_keys, identity_token) VALUES (new.scope_id, new.artifact_id, new.revision, new.state_version, new.content_hash, new.projection_format, new.kind, new.text, new.searchable_text, new.tag_keys, 'i' || lower(hex(new.scope_id)) || 'x' || lower(hex(new.artifact_id))); END

CREATE TRIGGER pc_atomic_memory_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON pc_atomic_memory_current BEGIN DELETE FROM pc_atomic_memory_current_fts WHERE identity_token MATCH ('i' || lower(hex(old.scope_id)) || 'x' || lower(hex(old.artifact_id))); INSERT INTO pc_atomic_memory_current_fts (scope_id, artifact_id, revision, state_version, content_hash, projection_format, kind, text, searchable_text, tag_keys, identity_token) VALUES (new.scope_id, new.artifact_id, new.revision, new.state_version, new.content_hash, new.projection_format, new.kind, new.text, new.searchable_text, new.tag_keys, 'i' || lower(hex(new.scope_id)) || 'x' || lower(hex(new.artifact_id))); END
